comment: B3 Round 24 — composite (cell, subject) state-key encoding determinism + reserved-name collision rejection. Spec authority: data-structures/cell-and-state-key.md (canonical state_key form) + encoding.md §9.5 (state_subject = base64url_nopad(sha256(canonical_json(components_array)))). The state_subject hash is canonical and kind-independent. The reserved cell-family names `__bottom__` (lattice-bottom diagnostic surface) and `__compaction__` (compaction marker surface) MUST NOT be reusable as user-supplied subject components — encoders MUST reject any components_array containing those literals.

encoder.canonical_json: RFC 8785 / encoding.md §1: arrays preserve order, object keys sorted, no whitespace
encoder.ordering_property: components_array ordering is deterministic per kind; reordering produces a different hash

vectors.name: flow_track_member_alice_distinct_track
vectors.comment: Same flow_id + actor_id as flow_track_member_alice but different track segment — must produce a distinct state_subject.

ordering_negative_vectors.name: wrong_component_order_must_differ
ordering_negative_vectors.comment: Component reordering (track before flow_id) MUST produce a different hash than the canonical order. Encoders that emit canonical state_subject by reordering would diverge.

reserved_name_negatives.name: bottom_reserved_rejected
reserved_name_negatives.comment: `__bottom__` is the spec-reserved lattice-bottom diagnostic surface name. Encoders MUST refuse to admit user-supplied components_array containing this literal anywhere. The hash, were it computed, would still be deterministic — but the encoder must reject before computing.

reserved_name_negatives.name: compaction_reserved_rejected
reserved_name_negatives.comment: `__compaction__` is the spec-reserved compaction-marker surface name. Even when not the sole component, ANY position MUST trigger rejection.

reserved_name_negatives.name: bottom_token_in_inner_position_rejected
reserved_name_negatives.comment: Reserved-token check is positional-agnostic — even when nested as a middle component, encoders MUST reject.
